about.title: About Ellysia
about.intro: Ellysia is a {project}: a test bench where its author builds and experiments with cybersecurity tools. {notService} No accounts are offered, nothing can be purchased and there is no company behind it.
about.introNotService: It is not a service or a commercial product.

modules.themis: vulnerability detection with its own engine (Lybra) and classic scanners for comparison.
modules.aegis: security awareness training generated with artificial intelligence.
modules.iris: email analysis to detect fraud (phishing), with the verdict explained.
modules.acheron: a password vault encrypted in the browser: the key never travels to the server.
modules.hygeia: monitoring of the health of servers and devices.

about.idea: The motivation is to learn and explore what it would take for protection not to be a privilege of those who can afford a security team. If Ellysia were ever offered to other people, this page and the legal terms would change first.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Ellysia is a {project} and not a service: no accounts are offered to other people and nothing can be purchased. This note explains what data is processed about website visitors, which is all Ellysia knows about anyone other than its author.
privacy.controller: Gabriel Musteata, the project's author, as a private individual. You can get in touch through the GitHub profile {link}.
privacy.dataHeading: What data is stored about website visitors
privacy.data: Every time your browser requests something from Ellysia, the server writes it to its activity log: the {ip} the request comes from, the date and time, what was requested, the response given and how long it took.
privacy.purpose: to keep the server secure and diagnose errors.
privacy.legalBasis: the legitimate interest in protecting the server (article 6.1.f of the General Data Protection Regulation).
privacy.retention: each day is archived separately and deleted after {days} days.
privacy.access: only the author. It is not shared with anyone and never leaves the server, which is in Spain.
privacy.cookies: Ellysia {noCookies}, analytics tools, advertising or any tracking system. Nor does it load resources from other websites: fonts are served from its own server. That is why there is no cookie notice to accept.
privacy.storage: The browser only keeps, in its local storage, what is essential for the website to work: that you closed the personal project notice (until you close the tab), the color theme if you change it and, if you sign in, your session. You can delete it at any time from your browser settings.
privacy.rights: You can ask to access the data stored about you, to have it deleted or to stop it being processed. Since the log only stores IP addresses, say which address you visited the website from and on which dates. You can also file a complaint with the {authority}.
privacy.version: Version of {date}. If Ellysia were ever offered to other people, this note would first be replaced by a complete privacy policy.

philosophy.title: The philosophy behind Ellysia
philosophy.p1: Online security is no longer a matter for a few. Today, opening an email, saving a password or switching on a server is enough to be exposed. What changed was not the threat: it was who receives it.
philosophy.p2: Defending yourself, however, is still expensive. Half a dozen products, each with its own license and console, within reach of those who can pay a team to run them. Ellysia brings those pieces together {sky} — detect, train, verify, keep, watch — for those without a security department behind them.
philosophy.p3: We do not promise invulnerability; no honest person does. We promise that {privilege}.
philosophy.p3Privilege: defending yourself stops being a privilege

faq.title: What is usually hard to decide

passwordsLeave.q: Do my passwords leave my browser?
passwordsLeave.a: No. Acheron encrypts in your browser before sending anything: the server only sees ciphertext and never receives your master password or the key derived from it.

lostMasterPassword.q: What happens if I lose my Acheron master password?
lostMasterPassword.a: The vault's content is lost, and there is no way to recover it. It is the direct consequence of the key never travelling: if we could give it back to you, we could also read your secrets. Keep it where you would keep your house key.

technical.q: Do I need to be technical to use it?
technical.a: To launch an analysis and read the report, no: you choose a target and receive the written result. Installing the Hygeia agent on a server does require access to that machine.

hygeiaAgent.q: What does the Hygeia agent need?
hygeiaAgent.a: A lightweight service on the machine you want to watch. It is the agent that sends data out every few seconds, so no inbound port needs to be opened.

cost.q: How much does it cost to start?
cost.a: Nothing. The entry plan is free, asks for no card and never expires. If you run short of quota, the paid plans are further up.

site.hint: This server hosts several websites on the same address and each one is checked separately: the same issue can appear on more than one, and it has to be fixed on every site where it appears.

host_unreachable.title: The target did not respond.
host_unreachable.hint: The engine could not open any connection, so there is nothing to analyze. Check that the machine is on, that the address is right and that no firewall is dropping the traffic.

port_discovery_failed.title: Port discovery could not be completed.
port_discovery_failed.hint: The target was responding, but the sweep did not finish. It is usually a firewall cutting the probe halfway; try narrowing the port list.

no_results.title: The scanner finished without returning results.
no_results.hint: The tool ran but produced nothing to process. Launch it again; if it happens again, the target may be filtering the scan.

orphaned.title: The scan was interrupted when the service restarted.
orphaned.hint: It is not a problem with the target: the job was lost halfway and closed when the service started again. Launch it again.

timeout.title: Time ran out before it finished.
timeout.hint: The requested work did not fit in the requested time. It happens when a very wide port range meets a target with many open ports: every service found is analyzed afterwards, and that takes time too. Narrow the ports or raise the time limit in the launch panel.

internal_error.title: The engine hit an unexpected error.
internal_error.hint: The failure is in the product, not in your network. The details are in the server log; if it happens again with the same target, it is worth reporting.

unknown.title: The scan failed.
unknown.hint: The reason was not recorded — this scan predates the engine storing it.
